## Which is this?

- [ ] A change to the **packages** (`@specifica/format` / `@specifica/store`)
- [ ] A change to the **format** (the `.specifica/` convention)

Format changes are a public contract other tools implement, so they need more
discussion than a package change. Please say what breaks for existing
`.specifica/` directories if this lands.
